slides.title: Solve any equation without algebra
slides.question: What value of $x$ satisfies $3x - 7 = 11$?
slides.caption: Graph each side as its own line: $y = 3x - 7$ and $y = 11$. The crossing sits at $x = 6$.

slides.title: Quadratics: click, don't factor
slides.question: What are the solutions to $x^2 - 2x - 8 = 0$?
slides.caption: Click the grey dots on the $x$-axis: $x = -2$ and $x = 4$. The vertex is marked too.

slides.title: Systems: the answer is a point
slides.question: What is the solution $(x, y)$ to the system $y = 2x + 1$ and $y = -x + 7$?
slides.caption: Click where the lines cross: $(2, 5)$. That ordered pair is the whole answer.
